auth.signInTitle: Sign in to continue using the app
auth.loginIssues: If you have login issues, please contact IT Helpdesk
auth.forgotPasswordHelp: If you forget your password, try signing in with Microsoft using the same email address.
auth.forgotPasswordPageText1: If your account uses the same Microsoft email, sign in with Microsoft because the password is managed by Azure AD.
auth.forgotPasswordPageText2: If Microsoft is temporarily unavailable, you can still use the email/password fields on the sign-in page if you registered a local password.
auth.forgotPasswordPageText3: If you are not sure, contact IT Helpdesk or try signing in again with Microsoft.
auth.forgotPasswordHint: After signing in, use the page above and choose the appropriate method for your account.
